features.name: Bard Starting Traits
features.description:
**Primary Ability:** Charisma
**Hit Point Die:** d8 per Bard level
**Saving Throw Proficiencies:** Dexterity and Charisma
**Skill Proficiencies:** Choose any 3 skills
**Weapon Proficiencies:** Simple weapons
**Tool Proficiencies:** Choose 3 Musical Instruments
**Armor Training:** Light armor
**Starting Equipment:** Choose A or B: (A) Leather Armor, 2 Daggers, Musical Instrument of your choice, Entertainer's Pack, and 19 GP; or (B) 90 GP

features.name: Bardic Inspiration
features.description:
You can supernaturally inspire others through words, music, or dance. As a Bonus Action, you can inspire another creature within 60 feet of yourself who can see or hear you. That creature gains one of your Bardic Inspiration dice.

Once within the next hour when the creature fails a D20 Test, the creature can roll the Bardic Inspiration die and add the number rolled to the d20.

**Uses:** Charisma modifier (min 1) per Long Rest. **Die progression:** d6 (L1), d8 (L5), d10 (L10), d12 (L15).

payload.name: Bardic Inspiration
payload.description: Grant a creature within 60 ft (who can see or hear you) a Bardic Inspiration die. Usable once within 1 hour to add to a failed D20 Test.

features.name: Spellcasting
features.description:
You have learned to cast spells through your bardic arts. Charisma is your spellcasting ability.

**Spell save DC** = 8 + your proficiency bonus + your Charisma modifier
**Spell attack modifier** = your proficiency bonus + your Charisma modifier

**Cantrips:** 2 (L1), 3 (L4), 4 (L10). Chosen from the Bard spell list.
**Prepared Spells:** Fixed by class table. Starting at 4 at L1, scaling to 22 at L20. Chosen from the Bard spell list (expanded via Magical Secrets from L10).

You can use a Musical Instrument as a Spellcasting Focus.

features.name: Expertise
features.description:
You gain Expertise in two of your skill proficiencies of your choice. Performance and Persuasion are recommended if you have proficiency in them.

At Bard level 9, you gain Expertise in two more of your skill proficiencies of your choice.

choices.name: First Expertise
choices.description: Choose one of your skill proficiencies to gain Expertise in.

choices.name: Second Expertise
choices.description: Choose another of your skill proficiencies to gain Expertise in.

features.name: Jack of All Trades
features.description: You can add half your Proficiency Bonus (round down) to any ability check you make that uses a skill proficiency you lack and that doesn't otherwise use your Proficiency Bonus.

features.name: Bard Subclass
features.description: You gain a Bard subclass of your choice. The College of Lore subclass is detailed after this class's description. A subclass is a specialization that grants you features at certain Bard levels. For the rest of your career, you gain each of your subclass's features that are of your Bard level or lower.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement (Level 4)
features.description: You gain the Ability Score Improvement feat or another feat of your choice for which you qualify.

choices.name: ASI or Feat
choices.description: Choose the Ability Score Improvement feat or another feat you qualify for.

features.name: Font of Inspiration
features.description:
You now regain all your expended uses of Bardic Inspiration when you finish a Short or Long Rest.

In addition, you can expend a spell slot (no action required) to regain one expended use of Bardic Inspiration.

features.name: Countercharm
features.description: You can use musical notes or words of power to disrupt mind-influencing effects. If you or a creature within 30 feet of you fails a saving throw against an effect that applies the Charmed or Frightened condition, you can take a Reaction to cause the save to be rerolled, and the new roll has Advantage.

payload.name: Countercharm
payload.description: React when you or an ally within 30 ft fails a save vs Charmed or Frightened; reroll with Advantage.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement (Level 8)
features.description: You gain the Ability Score Improvement feat or another feat of your choice for which you qualify.

choices.name: ASI or Feat
choices.description: Choose the Ability Score Improvement feat or another feat you qualify for.

features.name: Expertise (Level 9)
features.description: You gain Expertise in two more of your skill proficiencies of your choice.

choices.name: First Expertise
choices.description: Choose one of your skill proficiencies to gain Expertise in.

choices.name: Second Expertise
choices.description: Choose another of your skill proficiencies to gain Expertise in.

features.name: Magical Secrets
features.description: You've learned secrets from various magical traditions. Whenever you reach a Bard level (including this level) and the Prepared Spells number in the Bard Features table increases, you can choose any of your new prepared spells from the Bard, Cleric, Druid, and Wizard spell lists, and the chosen spells count as Bard spells for you. In addition, whenever you replace a spell prepared for this class, you can replace it with a spell from those lists.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement (Level 12)
features.description: You gain the Ability Score Improvement feat or another feat of your choice for which you qualify.

choices.name: ASI or Feat
choices.description: Choose the Ability Score Improvement feat or another feat you qualify for.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement (Level 16)
features.description: You gain the Ability Score Improvement feat or another feat of your choice for which you qualify.

choices.name: ASI or Feat
choices.description: Choose the Ability Score Improvement feat or another feat you qualify for.

features.name: Superior Inspiration
features.description: When you roll Initiative, you regain expended uses of Bardic Inspiration until you have two if you have fewer than that.

features.name: Epic Boon
features.description: You gain an Epic Boon feat or another feat of your choice for which you qualify. Boon of Spell Recall is recommended.

features.name: Words of Creation
features.description: You have mastered two of the Words of Creation: the words of life and death. You therefore always have the *Power Word Heal* and *Power Word Kill* spells prepared. When you cast either spell, you can target a second creature with it if that creature is within 10 feet of the first target.
